<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="参数对比"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#参数对比">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">参数对比</span></h2>

<div aria-label="注意" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-600/20" data-callout-type="note" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-4 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M 9 1.6714 C 13.0371 1.6714 16.3286 4.9629 16.3286 9 C 16.3286 13.0371 13.0371 16.3286 9 16.3286 C 7.0574 16.3252 5.1953 15.552 3.8217 14.1783 C 2.448 12.8047 1.6748 10.9426 1.6714 9 C 1.6714 4.9629 4.9629 1.6714 9 1.6714 Z M 9 0 C 4.0371 0 0 4.0371 0 9 C 0 13.9629 4.0371 18 9 18 C 13.9629 18 18 13.9629 18 9 C 18 4.0371 13.9629 0 9 0 Z M 10.2857 3.8571 H 7.7143 V 10.2857 H 10.2857 V 3.8571 Z M 10.2857 11.5714 H 7.7143 V 14.1429 H 10.2857 V 11.5714 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="none"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">当 <code>temperature</code> 接近 0 时，<code>n</code> 只能为 1，否则将返回 <code>invalid_request_error</code>。</span></div></div>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="模型参数配置差异"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#模型参数配置差异">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">模型参数配置差异</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">切换模型时，除了替换 <code>model</code> 字段，还需要注意各模型对请求参数的支持范围和默认值不同：</span>

base-ui-disable-scrollbar" data-component-part="scroll-area-viewport" data-id="base-ui-_R_1klbddbsnlhjiuqsnpfiutb_-viewport" role="region" style="overflow:scroll" tabindex="-1"><div class="flex" data-component-part="scroll-area-content" role="presentation" style="min-width:fit-content"><div class="px-(--page-padding) grow max-w-none table"><table class="m-0 min-w-full w-full max-w-none table [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_td[data-numeric]]:tabular-nums [&amp;_td]:min-w-[150px]"><thead><tr><th>参数</th><th><code>kimi-k3</code></th><th><code>kimi-k2.7-code</code></th><th><code>kimi-k2.6</code></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>上下文窗口</td><td>1M tokens</td><td>256K tokens</td><td>256K tokens</td></tr><tr><td><code>thinking</code></td><td>—</td><td>可省略；显式设置时仅接受 <code>{"type":"enabled","keep":"all"}</code></td><td><code>{"type":"enabled"}</code>（默认）、<code>{"type":"disabled"}</code>、<code>{"type":"enabled","keep":"all"}</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>reasoning_effort</code></td><td><code>"low"</code> / <code>"high"</code> / <code>"max"</code>（默认 <code>"max"</code>）</td><td>不支持</td><td>不支持</td></tr><tr><td><code>tool_choice</code></td><td><code>auto</code> / <code>none</code> / <code>required</code></td><td>不支持 <code>required</code></td><td>不支持 <code>required</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>temperature</code></td><td>固定 <code>1.0</code></td><td>固定 <code>1.0</code></td><td>思考 <code>1.0</code> / 非思考 <code>0.6</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>top_p</code></td><td>固定 <code>0.95</code></td><td>固定 <code>0.95</code></td><td>固定 <code>0.95</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>n</code></td><td>固定 <code>1</code></td><td>固定 <code>1</code></td><td>固定 <code>1</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>presence_penalty</code> / <code>frequency_penalty</code></td><td>固定 <code>0</code></td><td>固定 <code>0</code></td><td>固定 <code>0</code></td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></div>
<div aria-label="注意" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 dark:border-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-600/20" data-callout-type="note" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-4 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M 9 1.6714 C 13.0371 1.6714 16.3286 4.9629 16.3286 9 C 16.3286 13.0371 13.0371 16.3286 9 16.3286 C 7.0574 16.3252 5.1953 15.552 3.8217 14.1783 C 2.448 12.8047 1.6748 10.9426 1.6714 9 C 1.6714 4.9629 4.9629 1.6714 9 1.6714 Z M 9 0 C 4.0371 0 0 4.0371 0 9 C 0 13.9629 4.0371 18 9 18 C 13.9629 18 18 13.9629 18 9 C 18 4.0371 13.9629 0 9 0 Z M 10.2857 3.8571 H 7.7143 V 10.2857 H 10.2857 V 3.8571 Z M 10.2857 11.5714 H 7.7143 V 14.1429 H 10.2857 V 11.5714 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-rule="evenodd" stroke="none"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">表中”固定”表示该参数不可修改：传入其他值会报错，建议不要显式传入。</span></div></div>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="thinking"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#thinking">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>thinking</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><code>thinking</code> 是 K2.x 专属请求参数：</span>
<ul>
<li><code>kimi-k2.6</code>：支持 <code>{"type": "enabled"}</code>（默认）、<code>{"type": "disabled"}</code>、<code>{"type": "enabled", "keep": "all"}</code> 三种配置。</li>
<li><code>kimi-k2.7-code</code>：思考默认开启，仅支持 <code>{"type": "enabled", "keep": "all"}</code>，传入其他配置会报错。从 <code>kimi-k2.6</code> 切换时，需要按 Preserved Thinking 的要求在 <code>messages</code> 中回传历史 <code>reasoning_content</code>。</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">详见<a class="link" href="/docs/guide/use-thinking-models">使用思考模式</a>。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="reasoning_effort"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#reasoning_effort">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>reasoning_effort</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p">K3 始终进行推理思考且保留式思考（Preserved Thinking）始终开启。通过请求顶层 <code>reasoning_effort</code> 配置推理强度，支持 <code>"low"</code> / <code>"high"</code> / <code>"max"</code> 三档，默认 <code>"max"</code>。详见<a class="link" href="/docs/guide/use-reasoning-effort">推理强度</a>。</span>
<div aria-label="警告" class="callout my-4 px-5 py-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl flex gap-3 border border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-900 dark:bg-yellow-600/20 [&amp;_[data-component-part='callout-icon']]:mt-px" data-callout-type="warning" role="note"><div class="mt-0.5 w-4" data-component-part="callout-icon"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="flex-none size-5 text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M 9 6.75 v 1.5 m 0 3 h 0.0075 m -5.2035 3 h 10.392 c 1.155 0 1.8765 -1.2503 1.299 -2.25 L 10.299 3 c -0.5775 -0.9997 -2.0205 -0.9997 -2.598 0 L 2.505 12 c -0.5775 0.9997 0.144 2.25 1.299 2.25 z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5"></path></svg></div><div class="text-sm prose dark:prose-invert min-w-0 w-full [&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-light dark:[&amp;_kbd]:bg-background-dark [&amp;_code]:text-current! [&amp;_kbd]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:text-current! [&amp;_a]:border-current [&amp;_strong]:text-current! text-yellow-800 dark:text-yellow-300" data-component-part="callout-content"><span data-as="p">切换档位会破坏前缀缓存命中，建议在会话开始前确定 <code>effort</code> 档位，避免中途切换。</span></div></div>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="tool_choice"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#tool_choice">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>tool_choice</code></span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><code>kimi-k3</code> 支持 <code>auto</code> / <code>none</code> / <code>required</code> 三档；<code>kimi-k2.6</code> 与 <code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 不支持 <code>required</code>，传入会报错。详见<a class="link" href="/docs/guide/use-tool-choice">工具调用约束</a>。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="temperature"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#temperature">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer"><code>temperature</code></span></h3>
<ul>
<li><code>kimi-k2.6</code>：思考模式固定 <code>1.0</code>，非思考模式固定 <code>0.6</code>，传入其他值报错；</li>
<li><code>kimi-k2.7-code</code>：固定 <code>1.0</code>，传入其他值报错。</li>
<li><code>kimi-k3</code>：固定 <code>1.0</code>，传入其他值报错。</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">建议调用以上模型时不要显式传入 <code>temperature</code>。</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed</code> 与 <code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 为同一模型、参数约束完全一致，仅输出速度不同。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="常见问题"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#常见问题">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">常见问题</span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><strong>从 <code>kimi-k2.6</code> 切换到 <code>kimi-k3</code>，需要改代码吗？</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">将 <code>model</code> 替换为 <code>kimi-k3</code>，并移除 K2.x 的 <code>thinking</code> 配置；如需显式设置推理强度，使用顶层 <code>reasoning_effort</code>。K3 的多轮对话和工具调用需要把 API 返回的完整 assistant message 原样回传到 <code>messages</code>，包括可能返回的 <code>reasoning_content</code>。</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>从 <code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 切换到 <code>kimi-k3</code>，需要改代码吗？</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">替换 <code>model</code> 即可，并继续原样回传完整 assistant message；如需显式设置推理强度，使用顶层 <code>reasoning_effort</code>。</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong>原来代码里用的是 OpenAI 的 <code>reasoning_effort</code>，切到 <code>kimi-k3</code> 需要改吗？</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">不需要。K3 支持顶层 <code>reasoning_effort</code>，可选值为 <code>"low"</code> / <code>"high"</code> / <code>"max"</code>，默认 <code>"max"</code>。</span>
<span data-as="p"><strong><code>tool_choice: "required"</code> 在 <code>kimi-k2.6</code> / <code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 上能用吗？</strong></span>
<span data-as="p">不能。这两个模型不支持 <code>required</code>，传入会报错；该档位仅 <code>kimi-k3</code> 支持。</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="kimi-k2-7-code-系列-—-thinking-参数"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#kimi-k2-7-code-系列-—-thinking-参数">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Kimi K2.7 Code 系列 — thinking 参数</span></h2>
<span data-as="p"><code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 系列包含 <code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 及其高速版 <code>kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed</code>，二者为同一模型、参数约束完全一致（含上方表格与 <code>thinking</code> 行为），仅输出速度不同，下文统称 <code>kimi-k2.7-code</code>。</span>
<span data-as="p"><code>kimi-k2.7-code</code> 面向代码场景，除 <code>thinking</code> 外的参数约束与 <code>kimi-k2.6</code> 完全一致。与 <code>kimi-k2.6</code> 不同的是，它 <strong>始终开启思考、不可禁用</strong>（传入 <code>{"type": "disabled"}</code> 会报错），且 <strong>Preserved Thinking 始终开启</strong>（<code>thinking.keep</code> 不传或传 <code>"all"</code> 都按 <code>"all"</code> 处理，传入其他非法值会报错）。因此调用时无需传入 <code>thinking</code> 参数，只需切换 <code>model</code> 即可，模型始终输出 <code>reasoning_content</code>。详细用法见<a class="link" href="/docs/guide/use-thinking-models">使用思考模式</a>。</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-medium" id="kimi-k2-6-—-thinking-参数"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#kimi-k2-6-—-thinking-参数">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Kimi K2.6 — thinking 参数</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Kimi K2.6 支持通过 <code>thinking</code> 参数控制是否启用深度思考。接受 <code>{"type": "enabled"}</code> 或 <code>{"type": "disabled"}</code>。</span>
<span data-as="p">由于 OpenAI SDK 没有原生的 <code>thinking</code> 参数，需要使用 <code>extra_body</code> 传递：</span>
